u0: Initial state: the box has not yet been picked up and the task is in its starting phase. Move to the box and pick it up, which advances to u1, then carry it toward the exit. Do not step onto the exit without holding the box; reaching the exit empty-handed enters the absorbing failure state u3. Reaching the exit while holding the box succeeds in u4.
u1: The box has been acquired and the agent is in the normal delivery phase, normally while carrying it and not at the exit. Keep possession of the box and go to the exit; arriving there with the box enters the success state u4, while arriving without it enters failure u3. If the box falls, the next state is u2 and it must be picked up immediately.
u2: The box has just fallen and is not currently held; this is the one-step recovery state. On the very next move, pick the box up: a successful pickup advances to u1 with a small reward. If the next step ends without holding the box and without another fall, the RM enters the absorbing failure state u3. Another fall keeps the agent in u2, and reaching the exit while holding the box succeeds in u4.
u3: Absorbing failure state: the agent reached the exit without the box or failed to recover the box on the move immediately after a fall. The task is effectively lost and no further reward can be earned; all transitions remain in u3. The policy should avoid any action leading here, especially exiting empty-handed or delaying after a box fall.
u4: Terminal success state: the agent reached the exit while holding the box. The task is complete and the main reward has been earned; no further objective remains and all transitions stay in u4.
